<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Get the size of the note, including name, descriptor, and padding.</p>


<p>Both the start and the end of the descriptor are aligned by the section alignment. In practice many 64-bit systems deviate from the generic ABI by using sh_addralign=4.</p>
